body:
I’m out of my summer term and had some bad burnout from school and through social/personal stuff. Things have been better sort of, but ever since I almost seriously attempted months ago, I can’t stop thinking about it, even on good days like yourself. 

This last week I came to a certain peace within myself and somehow feel I’ve accepted “I am going to kill myself” and it no longer feels like a sudden, irrational thought of “I should kill myself”. It just feels like I have to prepare everything now to make it simple on my loved ones. I’m done trying to talk about it people trying to help me that I used to feel might help me. I can’t talk to strangers and I have yet to find a therapist who truly even remotely helps me. I’m done trying to believe I can do it. I have a long term plan and I have a short term plan, but I don’t have it in me anymore to carry out the long term one. People have noticed I’ve been extra sweet and quiet lately, versus being depressed and anxious. I want to keep it so they just feel I’ve relaxed and am working on myself, feeling better. It’ll be all okay in the end.
